title: Interview story deck for a product-strategy role (fictional candidate)

slides.title: I turn messy customer problems into products people come back to
slides.subtitle: Asha Rao · three stories, one way of working

notes.say: Thank you for having me. I'll tell you three short stories and what they say about how I'd work here.

slides.quote: Nobody on our street could tell which pharmacy actually had the medicine in stock.
slides.attribution: My neighbour, 2023: the sentence that started my first product

notes.say: Every product I've built started with a sentence like this one. This one came from my neighbour.

slides.title: What happens when you listen before you build?
Ten weeks of listening grew weekly users {=growth|.0f}x

notes.say: We went from about twelve hundred to over nine thousand weekly users in ten weeks, and we spent nothing on ads. The change was trust: live stock, not a static list.

slides.title: The same four steps run through every project

notes.say: Across all three stories the method was the same. Listen first, size the problem, ship something small, and measure.

slides.so_what: The pharmacy finder's live stock feed came out of interview 14.

slides.claim: My first 30 days go to your customers, not your roadmap
points: One problem sized and shared by day 45
A first small release by day 90

notes.say: Here is what that means for this role, concretely, for the first ninety days.

slides.title: Listen first, ship small, measure honestly
slides.ask: I'd love to bring this to your growth team

notes.say: That's my way of working. I'd love to bring it to your team. Happy to take questions.
